claim_text: Established a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows by defining deterministic route-policy dispatch, GraphRAG context-pack grounding, and human override escalation paths.
Advanced enterprise AI platform adoption through CFO-aligned adoption motions, connecting reusable workflow capabilities with usage-based forecasting and customer deal support.

Standardized the AI solution lifecycle with a production-readiness gate set across intake, validation, execution, monitoring, and remediation, enabling replayable runtime design and governed exits.
Architected high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms across AWS and Databricks Lakehouse data paths, vector services, and parallel decision workflows.
Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability through agentic platform productization and a scalable operating model.
